derivedFrom.note: timing limits are program cost at p95: the operation wall p95 minus the runner's own node floor median, measured in the same job

timing.why: the limits below were derived on one machine and have never been measured on a CI runner, so a failure there would be evidence about the runner rather than about the change; arm this by re-deriving on the runner with --write-budgets

a1Crashes.why: the store has never met this: at 200 parallel writers a few processes throw an uncaught `Error: database is locked` from `pragma journal_mode = wal` at src/adapters/store/index-cache.ts:85, which runs before `pragma busy_timeout = 5000` at line 87

a5SilentDrops.why: the store has never met this: a record heading renamed out of the grammar is dropped from every query with no finding

peakRssReadKb.source: DR8, 100 MiB for a read at 50k
peakRssReadKb.why: the landed store has never met this: a read at 50k peaks at about 182 MiB against DR8 100 MiB, measured twice

peakRssMutationKb.source: DR8, 120 MiB for a mutation at 50k
peakRssMutationKb.why: the landed store has never met this: a mutation at 50k peaks at about 212 MiB against DR8 120 MiB, measured twice

firstIndexBuildMs.source: DR8, 6 s for 50k items and 500k events
firstIndexBuildMs.why: the landed store has never met this: 11.1 s against DR8 6 s, and the figure is a wall time that a different runner would move on its own

reindexAfterHandEditMs.source: DR8, 50 ms after a hand edit of the largest shard
reindexAfterHandEditMs.why: the landed store has never met this: 257 ms against DR8 50 ms, and the figure is a wall time that a different runner would move on its own

indexToTextRatio.source: DR8, index at most 1.0x the text size
indexToTextRatio.why: the landed index stores each record's and each event's source text, which the DR2 spike that measured 0.7x did not; the store owner has to decide whether the budget or the index changes

toleranceWhy: two identical four-scale runs on 2026-09-05 moved the median of twenty operations by at most 2.4% and moved the store-load floor's median by 15.3%; 25% clears the worst observed drift by 1.6x and the operation drift by 10x. The p95 moved 68.9% between the same two runs, which is why the gate reads the median.
